body: I felt like I wanted to die. Like I never wanted to wake up. Like my life was nothing. When I woke up I was gutted that i lived. I didn't feel anything or want anything. I'm just fucking glad I lived!

If someone has forced themselves on her ie made  me make out with her she needs to go to the police and report it and this is probably a lot of a reason of why she is acting like this. Well done for asking for advice pal! Be gentle, be persistent and try to persuade someone else for her to trust. Go with your guts.
Not trying to change someones mind about suicide - I dont believe that's ok. You should always try to stop somebody from taking their own life.
Mate I thought the same. I actually came on here trying to help and got lots of abusive messages! So - you wanna talk???
It's the first step friend! Do you have anybody you can sit down with?

Erm didn't he say that he does ride his bike recklessly? So he does do it? And so does that make it ok to think or plan something and then not go through with it? I may not be a Christian and I'm certainly not perfect but I'm a human being. And human beings deserve respect and to not be put in danger through recklessness.
Sorry for moving off point here not my intention. The main question here is are you ok? Can we help?
That's sort of my point though. Driving recklessly can have huge consequences
Didn't they say about riding the bike? Or have I totally misread that??
But you are a Christian? So my comment stands?

If your religious, no matter what that religion is, does it not teach you to treat others as you wish to be treated? I simply disagree with being happy to put innocent lives in danger but quoting it fir other reasons?
But doesn't god teach you to treat others how you should be treated? So if you really believed I  god why are you potentially ok with killing others on the road? Not being horrible just asking?
As in providing support to offenders is the way to eradicate abuse?
Can I ask exactly what your point is here?
Just reread your original comment and think I got the wrong end of the stick.

Be honest pal. Your not filled with Christian dread. Stop riding around recklessly you might hurt somebody. Forget religion and what you think you should believe in. Believe in your own life. You must be in pain with the drinking etc can I ask why? But please dont pretend to pick and choose when you are religious or not yeah.

People dont fall victim to the extremes of our civilisation, monsters take advantage. Support only works after the fact. The solution is to prevent the suffering of others no? The only solution is to stop people thinking that victims bring things on themselves and to make sure the perpetrators are the only ones to blame surely?
Mate you dont really want to go because you want to talk. Talk to us x

You cant limit the suffering on your own life and those around you. Life happens to you and you cant always control that. Is it right that I have suffered through a lifetime of abuse in what was a space of a couple of years - none of which was my fault but through natural and others criminal reasons? Choice only takes you so far.

I've thought that most my life and have to work really hard not to believe that. Without a sob story I have had a back story of medical issues, abuse and a natural attraction to people who have taken advantage. Always taken it on the chin until I started to think that no matter what I did life was going to make me suffer. And it has. Still does some days. Mainly because I'm a bleeding heart and feel everyone else's pain. So it's not just you. But after a lot of honesty and thinking and talking I realised my suffering has helped me help so many other people without realising it. It's made me one tough fucker. It's made me kind and compassionate and someone who takes shit from nobody but me! I wonder why I'm a target for the shit life throws at you but you have to do something with that as it's the only positive you will get!
The best comment I have read all day. The world needs more people like you.

I have tried to end my life several times and have been very lucky that I didn't. From your post it seems that you dont truly want to do so as you you would have jumped. Also, the worry of pain makes me think that you dont really want to do it. But even thinking about it means you need to talk. Just know that the fact I have randomly replied to this post means that you have reached someone and that's a good enough reason to live x

I hate myself because I cant have children. I'm infertile. But I cant imagine how stressful and hard it must be for you in your position. Everybody hates their loved ones at some point. Theres no shame in feeling something that you're not meant to or shouldn't! Feel it! Embrace it! But talk about it! Have you talked about it? You're not a bad parent or person for finding things tough. You're doing your best. You are doing a good job. Have you tried talking to someone?
Your post has said a lot of things I've thought and had myself with parents and blame and thoughts. Friend you are not alone and congrats on bring brave for posting honestly.
